title: The electromagnetic black project at the base

tellings.quote: the black project was a very interesting into itself.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, says that from 1990 to 1993 an overseas base where he served hosted a "black project", a secret programme kept off the books, that worked on electromagnetic technology. Sherman tells Michels about it as someone who was there, calling it "very interesting into itself".
